SELECT id, requirement_type, category, priority, description, acceptance_criteria, source
FROM functional_requirements
WHERE project_id = '{{ $json.id }}'
ORDER BY priority DESC, created_at ASC;

INSERT INTO shared_context (project_id, context_data, version, updated_by) VALUES ('{{ $json.projectId }}', '{{ JSON.stringify($json.sharedContext).replace(/'/g, "''") }}', {{ $json.contextVersion }}, 'prd-generator') RETURNING id;
UPDATE e2e_projects SET status = 'prd_generation', current_stage = 'component-catalog-discovery', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = '{{ $('Initialize Shared Context').first().json.projectId }}';
INSERT INTO prd_documents (project_id, markdown_content, version, created_at) VALUES ('{{ $json.projectId }}', '{{ $json.prdContent.replace(/'/g, "''") }}', 1, NOW()) RETURNING id;
UPDATE e2e_projects SET status = 'completed', completed_at = NOW() WHERE id = '{{ $('Generate Final PRD').first().json.projectId }}';
